about: Example rubric for an answer template. Weights sum to 1. Fix the rubric before round 1 and keep it for every round.

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.anchors: 90+: one read is enough; 70: a second read needed; below 50: the point is lost

criteria.name: evidence
criteria.anchors: 90+: every claim has a specific fact or number; 70: most do; below 50: claims without support

criteria.name: relevance
criteria.anchors: 90+: answers exactly what was asked; 70: some drift; below 50: answers another question

criteria.name: tone
criteria.anchors: 90+: plain and direct; 70: some filler; below 50: hype or vague praise
